The fewer/more-strokes distribution rule is stated at 3567-3575 and implemented at 3609-3617: each of `ld.frames`' own keyframes is split by POSITION, not by strokeId — for element index `e<n-1`, the new layer gets `strokes[e]` if present, else `[]` (a keyframe with FEWER strokes than the reference leaves the extra new layers blank at that frame, same as any other blank keyframe); for the LAST element (`e===n-1`), the new layer gets `strokes.slice(n-1)` — every stroke from index n-1 onward, so a keyframe with MORE strokes than the reference keeps the overflow grouped into the last new layer rather than losing it.
